name: Xavian
summary: Xavian lies in northeastern Ashenvale, where satyrs have claimed an ancient night elf temple. It is their chief seat in the forest, and they use its ruins for dark rites that spread demonic corruption through the woodland.

sections.title: A Seat of Shadow
sections.body: Xavian lies in Ashenvale's northeastern hills, west of Forest Song and north of Satyrnaar. Satyrs hold the ruined temple, once sacred to the night elves, and make it their chief stronghold in the forest. Their leaders, including Prince Raze and Geltharis, direct their followers from its desecrated arches and terraces. Across the grounds, satyrs perform rites against the woodland and use stolen Warsong oil to blight it. The place bears the name of Xavius, a highborne councilor who became the first satyr during the War of the Ancients after failing Sargeras.

sections.title: The Fallen Vanguard
sections.body: Sentinels and woodland guardians watch Xavian, though the satyrs' threat reaches beyond nearby enclaves such as Night Run. Dryad defenders recently entered the ruins to recover the sacred Branch of Cenarius, but suffered grievous losses. Anilia, a dryad, lies dying on the outer terraces. She was struck down while trying to stop the defilers from using holy relics in their dark incantations.

faq.q: Why is this place named Xavian?
faq.answer: Xavian takes its name from Lord Xavius, Queen Azshara's highborne courtier. During the War of the Ancients, he helped bring the Burning Legion to Azeroth. After displeasing Sargeras, Xavius became the first satyr, and the demonic curse spread to others of his kind.

faq.q: What are the satyrs doing here?
aliases: what are they doing in xavian
faq.answer: The satyrs use Xavian as their chief command center in Ashenvale. They perform dark rites to spread demonic corruption through the ancient forest, using defiled sacred relics such as the stolen Branch of Cenarius and oil taken from the Warsong orcs.

faq.q: Who is the dying dryad lying on the ground?
faq.answer: The dying dryad is Anilia. She joined an effort to recover the stolen Branch of Cenarius from the satyrs and was mortally wounded in the skirmish. She lies among the ruins, pleading for someone to reclaim the sacred branch before corruption overtakes it.

faq.q: How does Xavian differ from Satyrnaar or Night Run?
faq.answer: Satyrnaar and Night Run are notable satyr camps in Ashenvale, while Xavian is the political and ritual heart of their forces in the forest. High-ranking leaders such as Geltharis and Prince Raze make their base among its ruins.

angles.text: As a night elf, the desecration of an ancient temple by the twisted descendants of the Highborne is a bitter offense. The halls call for swift retribution.
As a druid, you are called to reclaim the Branch of Cenarius from the satyrs, who use fel rites to corrupt the land, and heal the grove's spiritual wounds.
